abstract.t: This document describes a proposed companion format for associating two frozen software-artifact commitments with attribution and revisioned claims. It specifies canonical signing bytes, separate trust and freshness checks, claim-making and verification procedures, and operational state boundaries. The intended implementing community is software-provenance maintainers, release operators and independent security reviewers. Existing IETF canonicalization and signature specifications are used without defining a new cryptographic primitive. Retained source comparisons, document- signature checks and synthetic tests are indexed with their limits. Application control-plane evidence is distinguished from deployment of the companion itself. A complete operational profile, independently authenticated trust and current-state evidence, and a verified field deployment remain prerequisites to an implementation- readiness claim.
